title: NFPC_Cement Mixer Parts
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC PHILADELPHIA DIV
detail_text: The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia intends to procure Cement Mixer Parts on a sole source basis from Kercher Enterprises, Inc. The proposed contract action is for supplies or servises for which the Government intends to solicit and award with only one source under authority of FAR 13.106(b). Any questions regarding this notice should be emailed to: jessica.m.kelley23.civ@us.navy.mil Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
